_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); subscription software signals with salesforce.com's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (CRM listed 2004-06-23)

pit_profile.why: 'Salesforce is a global leader in customer relationship management (“CRM”) technology that brings companies and their customers together.' 'The market for our service offerings is highly competitive, rapidly evolving and fragmented, and subject to changing technology with low barriers to entry, shifting customer needs and frequent introductions of new products and services.' 'The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be harmed.' (FY2023 10-K); DURABLE: no 10-K read calls the business cyclical ('cyclical' appears only of the economy's downturns); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is on the watch list for a subscription software company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance': the FY2023 10-K names cloud computing as salesforce.com's own model, the side that displaces on-premise software, not a substitute for it, and names no offshore delivery; ECOMMERCE, STREAMING, ENERGY_TRANSITION, EV and CRYPTO name no software business; GENAI is scoped to 'generative / autonomous AI substitutes the core product: software seats, IT services and BPO hours, professional information, search, education content, mobility': the scope names software seats, which salesforce.com sells, but a theme joins the watch list only from a company filing that names it as a competitive risk (the PEP GLP1 rule, as MSFT and GOOG apply it), and the FY2023 10-K names AI only in salesforce.com's own offerings ('We are increasingly building AI into many of our offerings.')), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY18-FY18 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +74.3%/yr (Q1 FY24 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.1-yr ex-FY14 ex-FY15 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 ex-FY23 median

BULL.desc: EPS +74.3%/yr (no FY18-FY18 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +74.3%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY18-FY18: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CRM (retrospective, 2023-03-10) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.17x (-140.8% downside to Bear $417.04 / +809.6% upside to Bull $1575.26) | Adj composite 2.10 vs market 1.00: gap +1.10 [UNDERVALUED] | -58% above the EPP floor $416.00 (160x FY24E $2.60) | Conservative 2-yr case: +715.2% total (+357.6%/yr) | At 66.6x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $229.03 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +14.4% YoY in Q4 FY23, forward revenues +10.1-10.4% (Q1 FY24 revenue guide (Q4 FY23 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
